title: Create: Redstone Tweaks
description: This Create addon adds the ability to control the Frogport using redstone.
body:
# Create: Redstone Tweaks

**Create: Redstone Tweaks** is a technical addon for the *Create* mod, developed specifically for the **NeoForge** mod loader. This mod extends the functionality of Frogports by adding the ability to flexibly control their logistical flows using redstone signals.

This addon integrates a special button into the Frogport's graphical user interface (GUI), allowing you to configure how the block responds to an incoming redstone signal, providing pinpoint control over your logistics.

### ⚙️ Four Operation Modes (Redstone Logic)

The toggle switch inside the Frogport interface allows you to choose one of four behaviors when the block receives a redstone signal:

* **Default:** The Frogport completely ignores the redstone signal. The block operates normally, simultaneously receiving incoming packages and sending outgoing ones.
* **Disable All:** When a redstone signal is applied, the Frogport completely suspends its operation. It stops both receiving new packages and sending already prepared ones.
* **Only Send:** An active redstone signal disables the receiving function. The Frogport sends packages into the network but will not accept any incoming ones.
* **Only Receive:** An active redstone signal blocks the sending function. The Frogport accepts incoming packages but suspends the delivery of its own outgoing packages.

### 🔌 Compatibility and Requirements

* **Platform:** Developed exclusively for the **NeoForge** mod loader.
* **Dependencies:** Requires the **Create** mod (version `6.0.0` or newer) to be installed.
* **Mod Compatibility:** Features full support for the **Create: Vibrant Vaults** mod — the added redstone modes and GUI button function flawlessly on all colored variants of Frogports.
* **The mod has Russian and English localization**
